title: getmarketinghomepagepublicaccess
description: Verify that a GET request to the root path / returns a 200 HTML page for the public marketing homepage without requiring authentication.

title: getloginpageauthenticationoptions
description: Verify that a GET request to /login returns a 200 HTML login page with email/password and passkey login options, accessible without authentication.

title: getsignuppageregistrationflow
description: Verify that a GET request to /signup returns a 200 HTML signup page for new user registration without requiring authentication.

title: getverifyemailstatuspage
description: Verify that a GET request to /verify-email returns a 200 HTML email verification status page accessible without authentication.

title: getdashboardauthenticatedaccess
description: Verify that a GET request to /dashboard with a valid authenticated session returns a 200 HTML dashboard page with widgets and sidebar navigation, and without valid session returns 401 or redirect to login.

title: gettasksboardanddeeplinkmodal
description: Verify that a GET request to /tasks with valid authentication returns a 200 HTML task board page, and that accessing /tasks with valid projectId and open taskUuid query parameters opens the task detail modal correctly; invalid parameters show error or no modal.

title: getchatinterfaceauthenticatedaccess
description: Verify that a GET request to /chat with valid authentication returns a 200 HTML chat interface with conversations and message threads, and without valid session returns 401 or redirect to login.

title: getcallslistandroomaccess
description: Verify that a GET request to /calls with valid authentication returns a 200 HTML calls list and scheduling interface, and that accessing /calls/{id}/room with valid session and permissions returns a 200 HTML LiveKit call room page; invalid permissions or missing LiveKit server returns error state.

title: getcalendarviewwithintegrations
description: Verify that a GET request to /calendar with valid authentication returns a 200 HTML calendar view with events, and that missing or unavailable integrations show empty or error states; without valid session returns 401 or redirect.

title: getemailinboxandcomposepages
description: Verify that GET requests to /email and /email/compose with valid authentication return 200 HTML pages for inbox listing and compose email respectively, and that without valid session returns 401 or redirect to login.
